scope: Authored CN/EN proposals; no shared topic/deep-dive or generated-card edits.

comparison.position: 从target采样轨迹以q/p构造真实接受分支质量，末步边缘化得到可微EAL训练目标；补充draft训练，不替代拒绝校正verifier。
comparison.tradeoff: 原始投机解码关注保持target分布的推理正确性，REAL关注固定验证过程下如何训练draft；本地只测小张量期望与梯度，不训练35Btarget/完整drafter。

analysis.title: 推理接受比与训练路径比方向相反，但服务于同一接受质量
analysis.body: 原始Speculative Decoding从draft q提出token，以min(1,p/q)接受并从[p−q]+校正，保证输出target分布。REAL的轨迹却由target p采样，用min(1,q/p)把其质量变成min(p,q)，训练更合适的draft。两者不是替代算法；错误交换比例会分别破坏推理分布或训练目标。一个loss在某点与代理值相同，也不能证明其梯度方向正确。

question.question: REAL训练用q/p，而投机解码推理用p/q，是否有一方写反了？
question.answer: 没有。两者采样分布不同：训练先从p采样，推理先从q提案；各自乘截断比后都形成min(p,q)质量。不能脱离采样来源复用比值，末步边缘化与拒绝残差也分别属于训练估计和推理校正。
question.example: 教学例：p(A)=0.4、q(A)=0.8，训练p质量0.4乘1；推理q质量0.8乘0.5，均为0.4。

update.summary: 补入真实接受分支的EAL训练目标，将target采样q/p训练权重与draft提案p/q推理校正区分；A100三seed仅验证损失/梯度机制，完整训练成本过高不复现。

comparison.position: Use q/p on target-sampled paths to preserve accepted-branch mass, then marginalize the final step for differentiable EAL training; this supplements drafter training rather than replacing verification.
comparison.tradeoff: Original speculative decoding preserves target-distributed inference, while REAL trains a drafter under a fixed verifier. Local work checks tensor expectations and gradients, not a 35B target or complete drafter.

analysis.title: Opposite training and serving ratios produce the same accepted mass
analysis.body: Original speculative decoding proposes from q, accepts with min(1,p/q), and corrects from the positive part of p−q to retain the target distribution. REAL samples from p and uses min(1,q/p) to produce min(p,q) mass while training the draft. These are complementary stages, not replacement algorithms. Swapping ratios breaks either inference or training. Equal scalar objective values at one point do not establish equal gradient directions.

question.question: Are REAL's q/p training weights inconsistent with speculative serving's p/q acceptance?
question.answer: No. Training samples from p and serving proposes from q; each clipped ratio converts its own sampling mass into min(p,q). Sampling provenance is essential. Final-step marginalization and residual correction belong to training estimation and inference correction respectively.
question.example: Teaching example: p(A)=0.4 and q(A)=0.8. Training multiplies 0.4 by one; serving multiplies 0.8 by 0.5. Both yield 0.4.

english.update: Add accepted-branch EAL training and distinguish target-sampled q/p weights from draft-proposal p/q verification. Three-seed A100 checks cover loss/gradient mechanics only; full training remains cost-deferred.

comparison.position: 在裁剪/整图压缩之间先提议动作，再用原/缩输入联合正确性H−B与validation固定FLOPs比决定是否回退。
comparison.tradeoff: PACE依据图像语义密度/局部细节分配budget并融合注意力选token；C²额外建模信息减少相对原图造成的正确率损益。本地没有学习风险头，不能以代数门控宣称超越PACE checkpoint结果。

analysis.title: 信息保留策略与是否值得回退，是两层不同判断
analysis.body: PACE的APC/DDAE问如何分配视觉预算和保留证据，C²-Routing问当前缩减相对原图是否产生可补救伤害以及节省是否值得。高缩减错误率可能来自两边共同失败，也可能被缩减收益抵消；因此不能用错误率代替H−B。实际收益还依赖外部风险预测校准与validation固定策略，公式正确并不表示已训练可靠路由。

question.question: 一个缩减输入的错误率很高，为什么不能仅据此否定PACE式预算或强制C²回退？
question.answer: 还需比较同题原图是否也错，以及缩减是否曾改善。预算是输入证据选择，回退风险是原/缩正确性差；共同失败不会被原图修复。两类机制的真实checkpoint范围与本地L1证据也不能混排。
question.example: 教学例：缩减在90%题上错，但原图也在同90%错，H=B=0；回退只增加计算，不改善期望正确率。

update.summary: 增加联合正确性风险与validation成本效用轴，区别如何保留视觉证据和是否值得回退；CPU仅执行策略核，未训练视觉路由，完整18数据集矩阵不复现。

comparison.position: Propose cropping or full-image compression, then gate fallback with original/reduced joint-correctness H−B risk and validation-fixed FLOP ratios.
comparison.tradeoff: PACE allocates budgets from image density/detail and fuses attention to retain tokens. C² additionally models the correctness change induced by reduction. The local risk head is not trained; policy arithmetic cannot outrank PACE checkpoint results.

analysis.title: Evidence retention and the value of fallback are separate decisions
analysis.body: PACE's APC/DDAE allocates visual budget and evidence. C² asks whether reduction causes repairable harm relative to the original and whether savings justify it. High reduced-input error can be shared failure, or offset by reduction benefits; it is not H−B. Real benefits require calibrated external risk predictions and validation-frozen policy. Correct equations do not establish a trained reliable router.

question.question: Why does high reduced-input error neither invalidate a PACE-style budget nor automatically force C² fallback?
question.answer: Check whether the original fails on the same questions and whether reduction sometimes helps. Budgeting selects evidence; fallback risk measures original-minus-reduced correctness. Shared failures are not repaired by originals, and checkpoint evidence cannot be ranked against local L1 arithmetic.
question.example: Teaching example: both variants fail on the same 90% of questions. H=B=0, so fallback spends more without improving expected correctness.

english.update: Add joint-correctness risk and validation-cost utility, separating evidence retention from fallback value. CPU work implements only the policy kernel; no visual router is trained and the full 18-dataset matrix is not reproduced.

comparison.position: 在预训练V-JEPA2联合帧表征上，以场景交换正例及同视频非重叠hard negative适配动作几何，再冻结供世界模型使用。
comparison.tradeoff: RS-JEPA用扫描视图和跨传感器邻域共识学习场景检索；OnlyAct希望保留动作、抑制场景。共享JEPA来源不代表优化目标相同。本地两者均只有独立公式/梯度L1，不提供图像检索或动作迁移能力排名。

analysis.title: 跨视图保持的内容，可以是场景，也可以是动作
analysis.body: RS-JEPA希望不同传感器检索到同一场景，并让其邻域关系一致；OnlyAct反而把动作保持但场景改变的样本拉近，用同场景不同窗作为难负例。二者对场景身份的需求不同，不能直接拼接一个通用InfoNCE就声称兼得。OnlyAct正负构造依赖光流/相机静动假设，局部候选mask与损失的CUDA通过不能验证这些语义假设。

question.question: RS-JEPA与OnlyAct都做表征学习，为什么不能用同场景跨传感器正例替代OnlyAct正例？
question.answer: 同场景对齐保留场景身份，而OnlyAct要跨场景保留动作。替换会改变不变性目标，甚至鼓励动作编码器依赖场景捷径。InfoNCE公式相似不说明配对语义相同，真实动作迁移需要独立验证。
question.example: 教学例：同一桥梁的SAR和光学图适合RS-JEPA；OnlyAct需要不同房间里的相同开门动作，而不是同房间任意两个动作。

update.summary: 补入从JEPA时空先验提取动作的对比适配，明确场景检索与动作场景解耦目标差异；A100三seed只验证精确bank/冻结投影/梯度，完整视频训练不复现。

comparison.position: Adapt pretrained V-JEPA 2 joint-frame geometry with scene-swapped positives and same-video disjoint hard negatives, then freeze it for a world model.
comparison.tradeoff: RS-JEPA learns scene retrieval using scan views and cross-sensor neighbourhood consensus; OnlyAct preserves action while suppressing scene. Shared JEPA ancestry does not equate objectives. Local formula/gradient L1 checks support neither retrieval nor action-transfer rankings.

analysis.title: The invariant content across views can be scene or action
analysis.body: RS-JEPA matches the same scene across sensors and aligns neighbourhoods. OnlyAct pulls together scene-changed action-preserving pairs while contrasting different times in the same scene. Their needs for scene identity differ; one generic InfoNCE cannot establish both. OnlyAct's pairing depends on flow and camera-motion assumptions. Passing CUDA candidate-mask and gradient checks does not validate these semantic assumptions.

question.question: Why can't same-scene cross-sensor pairs replace OnlyAct positives just because both methods learn representations?
question.answer: Same-scene alignment retains scene identity, whereas OnlyAct retains action across scenes. Substitution changes invariance and can reward scene shortcuts. Similar InfoNCE equations do not imply equivalent pair semantics; action transfer needs independent evidence.
question.example: Teaching example: SAR and optical images of one bridge suit RS-JEPA. OnlyAct instead needs the same door-opening action in different rooms, not arbitrary actions in one room.

english.update: Add contrastive action extraction from JEPA temporal priors and distinguish scene retrieval from action/scene disentanglement. A100 seeds check exact bank, frozen projection and gradients only; full video training is not reproduced.
